name: ExynosTools Xclipse LSFG r4
description: Samsung Xclipse compatibility driver for stock GameNative 1.2.0 wrappers. r4 implements the Android hwvulkan HAL ABI expected at GameNative's AdrenoTools custom-driver boundary, opens the real Samsung Vulkan HAL through the SP-HAL namespace, and hosts the ExynosTools compatibility layer without replacing any stock Wrapper component.
author: Vortek / ExynosTools
driverVersion: Samsung hwvulkan HAL + ExynosTools compatibility r4
